metadata.name: kapora
metadata.description: Kapora Protocol: trustless deposits (zadatek / zaliczka) for marketplaces

instructions.name: cancel_offer
docs: Payee cancels anytime while `Offered`; anyone may after the reserve deadline.

accounts.name: actor
docs: payee (anytime) or anyone after the reserve deadline

instructions.name: claim_after_deadline
docs: Anyone may settle after `complete_deadline + grace_secs`.

accounts.name: actor
docs: anyone (pays for missing token accounts)

instructions.name: confirm_complete
docs: Payer or payee confirms the deal happened. Second confirmation settles.

accounts.name: actor
docs: payer or payee

instructions.name: create_offer
docs: Payee opens an offer and locks their stake `S` in the vault.

instructions.name: expire_dispute
docs: Anyone may refund both sides if the arbiter stays silent.

accounts.name: actor
docs: anyone (pays for missing token accounts)

instructions.name: open_dispute
docs: Payer or payee escalates to the arbiter with a salted evidence hash.

instructions.name: reserve
docs: Payer locks deposit `D` and reserves the offer.

instructions.name: resolve
docs: Arbiter splits the vault (`payer_bps` / 10000 to the payer) and assigns fault.

accounts.name: actor
docs: the deal's arbiter

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Payer or payee backs out; the legal rule decides who gets what.

accounts.name: actor
docs: the party backing out (payer or payee)

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: StakeMustEqualDeposit
errors.msg: Zadatek requires payee stake == payer amount

errors.name: InvalidLegalParams
errors.msg: Parameters violate the legal label (zadatek: Forfeit + S == D + ToPayee; zaliczka: Refund)

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.msg: Instruction not allowed in the current deal status

errors.name: NotParty
errors.msg: Signer is not a party of this deal

errors.name: NotArbiter
errors.msg: Signer is not the arbiter of this deal

errors.name: NoArbiter
errors.msg: This deal has no arbiter; disputes are disabled

errors.name: DeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Deadline has not been reached yet

errors.name: SelfDeal
errors.msg: Buyer and seller must be different wallets

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: Token mint does not match the deal mint

errors.name: PayoutMismatch
errors.msg: Payout does not add up to the vault total

types.name: CreateOfferArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_offer`, bundled in a struct to keep the instruction readable.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = Standard. Anything else -> UnsupportedKind.

types.name: Deal
docs: One deal between a payee (creates the offer: seller / owner / freelancer) and a
(future) payer (locks the main amount: buyer / renter / client).
seeds: ["deal", payee, offer_id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: payer
docs: Pubkey::default() until `reserve`

fields.name: arbiter
docs: Pubkey::default() = no arbiter, disputes disabled

fields.name: platform
docs: integrating platform (anonymous stats only)

fields.name: payer_amount
docs: D

fields.name: payee_stake
docs: S (may be 0)

fields.name: template
docs: 0=Deposit, 1=Rental, 2=Freelance, 3=Purchase (label only)

fields.name: listing_hash
docs: salted SHA-256 of the listing; the salt lives off-chain

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: salted hash of dispute evidence (zero if none)

types.name: DealKind
docs: What kind of deal this is. The MVP only implements `Standard` (one-shot deal,
used by all four templates); future mechanics (milestones, attesters) get a
new variant + payout fn.

types.name: Fault
docs: Which party the arbiter found at fault (updates `disputes_lost`).

types.name: LegalLabel
docs: Legal label. Does not change the payout by itself but constrains the parameters:
Zadatek (PL Civil Code art. 394) => Forfeit + S == D + ToPayee; Zaliczka => Refund.

types.name: OnComplete
docs: Where `D` goes when both parties confirm. `S` always returns to the payee.

types.name: Penalty
docs: What happens to the party that backs out or stays silent past the deadline.

types.name: PlatformStats
docs: Anonymous aggregate counters per integrating platform.
seeds: ["stats", platform]

types.name: Profile
docs: Behaviour trail of a wallet. No identity — only counters.
seeds: ["profile", wallet]
